Problem Statement
Read N integers into an array, swap the first and last elements using a temporary variable, and print the array.
Description
Read an integer N, then read N integers into a one-dimensional array. Exchange the first element arr[0] and the last element arr[N - 1] using a temporary variable, in the same way two variables are exchanged. Print all N elements of the array after the exchange, separated by spaces. If N is 1, the array stays the same.
Input Description
An integer N (N >= 1), followed by N integers, all separated by spaces.
Output Description
Print the N elements of the array after the swap, separated by spaces, on one line.
Sample Input
5 1 2 3 4 5
Sample Output
5 2 3 4 1
